semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Inbound document record with source, file, metadata, provenance and review state before it becomes a business transaction.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics, Odoo and Epicor separate capture/digitization from validated AP posting.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Email or webhook may create an envelope and extraction candidate, not a posted AP liability.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Supplier invoice document that creates payable liability only after validation, matching and Ledger-governed posting.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP AP flows treat vendor invoice as the payable document, distinct from receipt and purchase order.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Creating/posting vendor bill requires AP route, Ledger handoff and approval policy.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Governed comparison of PO, receipt and supplier invoice with tolerances and exception workflow.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP, Dynamics, Epicor and Odoo use PO/receipt/invoice matching to prevent overbilling and payment errors.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Matching tolerance or automatic approval policy belongs to Control Plane and PO decision.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Clearing concept between goods received and invoice received; avoids direct AP liability from receipt when bill is not validated.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP-style GR/IR and market AP automation separate receipt from invoice liability.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Switching receipt accounting to GR/IR requires Ledger and Architect review.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Mismatch, low confidence, unknown supplier, duplicate invoice or policy violation requiring review before AP creation/posting.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Market automation routes humans to exceptions rather than manual entry for every invoice.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Automatic progression is allowed only for deterministic, policy-approved cases with audit trail.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Stateful movement of an inbound document through intake, validation, approvals, payment authorization and accounting handoff.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: AP automation suites route documents through workflow so people review exceptions, approve liabilities and authorize payment.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Workflow state changes can be deterministic only when policy and role ownership are explicit; otherwise escalate.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Secretary intake, goods receipt authorization, purchase validation, payment and accounting are distinct responsibilities unless policy permits combining them.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Enterprise AP workflows separate requester, receiver, approver, payer and accountant to reduce fraud and error.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Any policy that combines roles or skips an approval requires Control Plane and reviewer.
